question: What success in assembly is assured to the accomplished practitioner?
premises: The practitioner obtains victory in the assembly
The practitioner becomes equal to the speaker without doubt
inference: The accomplished practitioner gains assured victory and exalted parity in formal assemblies.
uncertainties: mama+tulyo: the identity of the speaker claiming equality is context-dependent
plain_english: He obtains victory in the assembly and becomes equal to me; there is no doubt.
